sub_questions.question: Can the finance team pay for the Team subscription by invoice or bank transfer instead of credit card?

claims.claim: Credit card is the only payment method available today on any Cloud plan.
claims.guide_evidence: Payment is by credit card by default; paying by invoice or bank transfer ... is not available on any plan today.

claims.claim: Dify is exploring a pay-by-invoice / bank transfer option.
claims.guide_evidence: paying by invoice or bank transfer is still being evaluated by Dify

claims.claim: If it ships, invoice/bank transfer is expected to apply only to annual Team subscriptions.
claims.guide_evidence: if it ships, is expected to be limited to annual Team subscriptions only

claims.claim: Invoice/bank transfer is not available currently.
claims.guide_evidence: it is not available on any plan today

claims.claim: Checking the Billing page periodically is a way to find out whether an invoice option has become available.
Dify's sales team is an appropriate contact if an invoice option is a hard requirement now.
claims.guide_evidence: Enterprise pricing and feature scope are negotiated directly with Dify's sales team

evaluation.rationale: The main answer matches the guide: invoice and bank transfer aren't available on any plan today, Dify is still evaluating them, and if they ship they're expected to cover annual Team subscriptions only. Two closing suggestions go beyond the guide: that the Billing page will show when invoicing becomes available, and that the sales team can help a Team-plan customer with invoicing (the guide only links sales to Enterprise). Neither suggestion is likely to harm the customer, so the answer is safe to send with minor issues.
